summary: End-to-end verification of Iter 63 Job File PDF export. Backend (existing pytest + new guards test): 16/16 pass across all 4 languages (en/de/tr/es) on both /api/pm/projects/{id}/export-pdf and /api/pm/my-projects/{id}/export-pdf, including 400 on non-done projects and 403 cross-role. Frontend Pro flow: button visible only on done projects, modal opens with 4-lang picker, DE download returns 200 application/pdf and success toast. Frontend Homeowner flow: button visible on done project, modal opens with 4-lang picker, EN download returns 200 application/pdf and success toast (after a pre-existing Quick reminder modal is dismissed). PM detail tabs (Overview/Kanban/Timeline/Materials/Diary/Billing/Customer Page) all clickable; HO project detail renders all key sections.

issues: Pre-existing 'Quick reminder' modal auto-opens on load and visually overlaps/obscures the 'Export Job File' button row until dismissed. Not caused by Iter 63 but degrades discoverability of the new export action; consider lowering its priority or showing it after the user-initiated interaction. The export feature works fine once the modal is closed.

critical_code_review_comments: ExportJobFileModal: API errors are swallowed into a single toast (pm_export_error). For 400/403 specifically you could surface a more actionable message (e.g. 'Project must be marked done before exporting').

Seed/test data drift: the project IDs in the review request (6a285e689f6cbbf89125899a was supposed to be active) no longer match runtime state (now 'done'). Pinning explicit IDs in test docs is fragile; recommend the test guide query an active project at runtime.
Minor pre-existing console warning unrelated to this feature: a <span> is being nested inside <option> somewhere in ProtectedRoute-rendered tree (React hydration warning).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the new export flow for both roles
